84633.m: Pixel art builds pictures out of small squares.

84634.e: Pixel is a made-up word from “picture element”. It is a single dot of a picture.
84634.m: A pixel is a single dot of a picture.

84635.q: A pixel art picture is 8 pixels wide and 8 pixels high. How many pixels does it have?
84635.e: There are 8 rows with 8 pixels each. 8 times 8 makes 64.
84635.m: The number of pixels is width times height.

84636.q: Where do you see pixel art especially often?
84636.e: Early computers could only show a few dots. That is why characters in old video games looked blocky.
84636.m: Old video games are famous for their pixel art.

84637.q: What can you use to make pixel art without a computer?
84637.e: Ironing beads are placed on a pegboard in rows. That makes a picture out of lots of dots of the same size.
84637.m: Ironing beads or squared paper are good for pixel art too.

84638.q: How many colours does a single pixel have?
84638.e: A pixel is the smallest part of a picture. It always has just one single colour.
84638.m: Each pixel has exactly one colour.

84639.q: What happens when a picture is made of more pixels?
a: It becomes finer and more precise
84639.e: With more dots you can show finer shapes. With few pixels a picture looks blocky.
84639.m: The more pixels a picture has, the finer it can be.

84640.q: On which paper is it especially easy to draw pixel art by hand?
84640.e: Squared paper is divided into small squares. You can colour in each square with one colour, like a pixel.
84640.m: On squared paper each square becomes a pixel.

a: A picture of what the screen is showing
A photo of the computer cable
A photo that you print out
84641.e: A screenshot records exactly what can be seen on the screen at that moment. You do not need a camera for it.
84641.m: A screenshot saves a picture of the screen.

84642.q: Which word is made of “screen” and “shot” and means a picture of the screen?
84642.e: A shot is a picture you take. Screen plus shot makes screenshot.
84642.m: A picture of the screen is called a screenshot.

84643.q: Which key takes a screenshot on many Windows computers?
84643.e: The Print Screen key copies a picture of the screen.
84643.m: With the Print Screen key you take a screenshot on a Windows computer.

84644.q: Where do you usually find a screenshot on a phone?
84644.e: The phone saves screenshots like other pictures. That is why they appear with the photos.
84644.m: On a phone, screenshots end up with the photos.

84645.q: What can a screenshot be useful for?
84645.e: With a screenshot you can show someone exactly what is happening on the device. That way another person can help better.
84645.m: With a screenshot you can show what you see on the screen.

84646.q: May you simply send a screenshot of a private chat to others?
84646.e: A chat is a private conversation. Forwarding it without permission can hurt others.
84646.m: I only pass on other people's private messages with permission.

84647.q: What kind of file is a screenshot?
84647.e: A screenshot is a still picture. That is why it is saved as an image file.
84647.m: A screenshot is saved as a picture.

84648.q: What is it called when you record the screen like a film?
84648.e: With a screen recording, everything that happens on the screen is saved as a video. A screenshot, on the other hand, only shows one moment.
84648.m: A screen recording saves the screen as a video.

84649.e: A video shows pictures that move. Usually you hear sound with it too.
84649.m: A video shows moving pictures, often with sound.

84650.q: What is a video actually made of?
84650.e: A video shows lots of pictures one after another very quickly. Our eyes see a smooth movement.
84650.m: A video is made of lots of single pictures shown quickly.

84651.q: Which symbol does the button for playing a video usually have?
84651.e: The triangle pointing to the right means play.

84652.q: What do two vertical lines on a video button mean?
84652.e: With the pause button the video stops. If you press it again, it carries on from the same place.

84653.q: What does a square on a video button usually mean?
84653.e: The square ends playback. After that the video often starts again from the beginning.
84653.m: A square on a button means stop.

84654.q: What is it called when you cut out parts of a video and put them together again?
84654.e: In video editing you remove boring bits and arrange the scenes. There are special programs and apps for this.
84654.m: In video editing a video is shortened and put together.

84655.q: How do you hold your phone so that a video is wide like on a television?
84655.e: A television is wider than it is tall. If you hold your phone sideways, the video has the same wide shape.
84655.m: For a wide video you hold your phone sideways.

84656.q: Roughly how many pictures per second does a video show?
84656.e: Many videos show 25 or 30 pictures every second. That is so fast that the movement looks smooth.
84656.m: A video shows about 25 to 30 pictures every second.

84657.q: What is the text at the bottom of a video that shows what is being said called?
84657.e: Subtitles write what is said as text on the screen. They help, for example, people who cannot hear well.
84657.m: Subtitles show what is said as text.

84658.q: What do you record sounds and voices with?
84658.e: A microphone turns sound into electrical signals. The device can then save them.
84658.m: You record sounds with a microphone.

84659.q: What do you use to play back a sound recording out loud in the room?
84659.e: A loudspeaker turns saved sounds back into sound you can hear. With headphones you listen on your own.

a: A programme to listen to on the internet
A photo album on the internet
84660.e: You can listen to a podcast on the internet whenever you like. There are often lots of episodes on one topic.
84660.m: A podcast is a listening programme from the internet.

84661.q: What can disturb a sound recording outdoors especially badly?
84661.e: Wind blows into the microphone and makes loud rushing noises. A windshield made of foam or fur helps against this.
84661.m: Wind can make a sound recording outdoors rush loudly.

84662.q: Where does a voice recording work best?
84662.e: In a quiet room there are no disturbing noises. That way the voice sounds clear.
84662.m: For good sound recordings you look for a quiet place.

84663.q: What does the jagged line that appears on the screen while recording show?
84663.e: The jagged line shows the sound wave. Big peaks mean loud sounds, small peaks quiet sounds.
84663.m: Big peaks in the sound wave mean loud sounds.

84664.q: What is a short sound recording that you send in a chat called?
84664.e: With a voice message you speak into the phone instead of writing. The other person listens to it later.
84664.m: A voice message is a spoken message in a chat.

84665.q: Which is a well-known format for sound files?
84665.e: MP3 is a very common format for music and speech. JPG, PNG and GIF are formats for pictures.
84665.m: MP3 is a well-known format for sound files.

84666.q: Why should you not speak too far away from the microphone when recording?
a: So the file is more colourful
84666.e: If you are too far away, the voice sounds quiet and other noises get louder. Close to the microphone you can be understood better.
84666.m: If you speak close to the microphone, you can be heard more clearly.

84667.e: Emojis are small pictures such as faces, animals or food. You put them in messages.
84667.m: Emojis are small pictures in messages.

84668.q: Which language does the word “emoji” come from?
84668.e: Emoji is Japanese: “e” means picture and “moji” means written character. The first emojis were on Japanese mobile phones.
84668.m: The word emoji comes from Japan.

84669.q: What do people often use emojis for in messages?
84669.e: A laughing or sad face shows how you feel. In written messages this helps you to be understood correctly.
84669.m: With emojis you can show feelings in messages.

84670.q: What does a thumbs-up emoji usually mean?
84670.e: The raised thumb is a sign of agreement. People often use it as a short “OK”.

84671.e: World Emoji Day is celebrated every year on 17 July. The date comes from the calendar emoji, which often shows 17 July.
84671.m: World Emoji Day is on 17 July.

84672.q: What does the sequence of characters :-) mean in a message?
84672.e: If you tilt your head to the side, you see eyes, a nose and a smiling mouth. Faces made of characters like this existed even before emojis.
84672.m: You can write a smiling face with punctuation marks.

84673.q: Does an emoji look exactly the same on every phone?
a: No, it looks a little different depending on the device
No, it always becomes black and white
Yes, but only in the evening
84673.e: Each company draws its own emojis. The meaning is the same, but colours and shapes can be different.
84673.m: An emoji can look different on different devices.

84674.q: What does an emoji with a tear and a sad mouth show?
84674.e: A tear and a mouth curved downwards stand for sadness. You use it to show that something is getting you down.

84675.q: What does a photo filter in an app do?
84675.e: A filter changes, for example, colours, brightness or contrast with one click. The photo then looks different.
84675.m: A photo filter changes how a photo looks with one click.
